title: ai-hooks rules file
description: Optional user rules, merged on top of the built-in defaults. Location: $AI_HOOKS_RULES or <config dir>/ai-hooks/rules.json.

redact_rules.description: A rule fires when every regex in match matches some line of the lower-cased command, none of unless does, and the command is not already piped through ai-hooks redact/exec.

why.description: One line shown to the agent.

secret_paths.description: Extra regex alternatives for a file that holds secrets (structural rule print-secret-file).

disable.description: Rule ids (redact or structural) to switch off.

allow.description: A command matching any of these regexes is never blocked.

redactors.description: Regexes that mean 'this command is piped through a redactor' (for a redactor other than ai-hooks).
